title: Derinkuyu underground city found by a man renovating his home

tellings.quote: he's he's basically working on his apartment and he knocks a wall down accidentally and he opens up this doorway opening

plain: Derinkuyu, a vast underground city in Turkey, is said to have been found by accident when a man fixing up his home knocked down a wall and opened "this doorway." A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells the story to Michels without naming a source, in an episode about what he believes happened around 12,000 BC.
